description: After a GO: the Self-checked badge code to paste into the site, and the link where anyone can check it. Checks the folder first and refuses while the verdict is NO-GO. Makes no network call unless SIGSHIP_KEY is set.

path.description: Absolute path of the project folder. Defaults to the server's working directory.

site.description: The site the badge is for, for example myapp.com.

name: sigship_badge

embed.description: The HTML to paste into the site.

id.description: The badge ID, for example SG-S-4K7Q2M.

level.description: S for Self-checked, D for Deep self-check.

verify.description: Where anyone can check the badge.
